title: A basic but useful app with a major issue
body:
The app looks nice and does what it says in the title. It’s a to-do list. However I whole heartedly cannot fathom how these devs think it’s okay to charge €9 a month for a pretty checklist with AI (that you definitely do not need). 

You’re telling me that you sincerely believe your list app offers the same monthly value as YouTube Premium or Spotify?
author: Trinket_Master

title: App User/Feedback
body:
I had high hopes for this app but if you struggle with executive functioning running out quickly and then not having any left for the tasks you need to get done then I don’t think this app is suitable. It’s very hard to edit tasks, change orders of how you inputted them and deleting/setting new routines. It doesn’t suit me as a person who needs to brain dump and then arrange the order of things. If you are someone who has already worked to set a very solid daily routine I think this app would be helpful for you. As someone still working with an OT to help set a routine this causes more issues and avoidance. 
I hope they continue to work on the app, take feedback seriously from those with neurodivergence, and make big leaps in improving the ease of use and interface. The AI aspect is also more frustrating than it is helpful.

title: Good, but prioritising AI integration over functionality
body: I used tiimo (with premium subscription) for most of the last 3 years, but I will now be moving to another app. If you look at the comments or feedback on anything related to Tiimo, you’ll see users asking for basic features that used to be in the app (especially the routines feature) to be brought back. However, every recent update focused on further integration of an AI assistant that is incapable of doing these tasks correctly. Asking the AI assistant to do same task several times or manually setting up all tasks is a huge executive functioning drain, making use of the app counterproductive at times. The interface, the timer design, and especially the apple watch integration I adore but I can’t justify paying for a service that has “planned” to bring back basic functionality for over a year.

title: Game Charger!
body: I’m a mom and business owner with ADHD and a kid with ASD. I have been using Tiimo for about 2 years and it’s always been a huge help! This app help me manage my day and all my kids appointments. And helps my keeps on top of my business related tasks and keep my house clean. My biggest with house was always the big tasks they you do every few weeks. Using the diction to have a task repeat every week/month or however long you need is exactly what I need!
